Surveys still describe adoption as early-stage in 2007, and item-level tagging spread mainly in apparel in the 2010s (GS1 US survey 2015). The mainstream year is an estimate, bounded after 2009, which is all the 2002 claim (placed 2007, partial unless mainstream by 2009) needs. year_5pct 2006 is low-to-moderate certainty. If the evidence showed under 5% by 2007, the claim would be a miss.
